current_date: Page last updated 27 August 2026 (no adoption date stated; cites SPDs from November 2025 and the Trees and Development SPD of February 2026)
current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation requirement' web page (last updated 27 Aug 2026) sets out requirements under the Bassetlaw Local Plan 2020-2038 and cites 2025-26 SPDs. The linked PDF is dated July 2018 and cites the old Core Strategy (CS/DM policies).

issues.detail: The workbook links the July 2018 'Validation Of Planning Application: Guidance Notes' PDF, which is based on the superseded Core Strategy. The current list is the council's Local validation requirement web page under Local Plan 2020-2038. Grokbot read both and mixed them, so the workbook combines requirements from both.
issues.evidence: PDF cover 'July 2018', cites CS2-CS9, DM4-DM13; web page cites 'Bassetlaw Local Plan 2020-2038', Policy ST11/ST38/ST50/ST52

issues.detail: List date 2019-01-01 comes from PDF metadata. The PDF text says July 2018 (viability section updated after Planning Committee on 5 Dec 2018). The current list is the web page, updated 27 Aug 2026.

Of the 12 tab_items, 8 are 'Drawing / document standards' fragments of form boilerplate, with phone numbers and page numbers. Five are near-identical copies of 'A1, A3) and an appropriate Scale Bar indicating a minimum of 0-10 metres'.
issues.evidence: 'A1, A3) and an appropriate Scale Bar indicating a minimum of 0-10 metres. 01909 533 533 35 Local Requirements Tick if included:'

issues.detail: Requirements on the current list that Grokbot did not capture as app-type rows: Biodiversity Net Gain Statement (all applications subject to mandatory BNG); Construction Traffic Management Plan (major development or development likely to cause disruption, including demolition); Health Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings); Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment (sensitive or highly visible locations, large renewables, minerals/waste); Noise Impact Assessment (noise-generating development, or noise-sensitive development near major noise sources); Marketing and Viability Information (loss of uses protected by the development plan); Recreational Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings within 10 km of Clumber Park SSSI; tab_items only); Retail & Leisure Impact Assessment (Policy ST11 thresholds; tab_items only); roof plans and section drawings; and the ICNIRP declaration for telecoms.

Householder, Reserved matters and s73 all say '(none)'. On the current page, plans/levels, Heritage Statement, Tree Survey and protected species surveys apply to any application meeting their triggers. The Planning Statement applies to major reserved matters and to 'applications to remove or vary conditions'. The 2018 PDF even has a dedicated Householder appendix (1A).
issues.evidence: Planning Statement: 'major development (including outline and reserved matters), HMOs, ... applications to remove or vary conditions'

issues.detail: 'Gypsy & Traveller information' appears under Listed building consent and Demolition in conservation area, but its trigger is Heritage Impact Assessment text, so it is a mis-tag. 'Lighting Assessment' sits under Listed building consent, though it applies to external lighting near a listed building or conservation area, not to LBC applications. 'Landscaping scheme' sits under Outline, with the trigger 'If not approved at outline stage', which is a reserved matters requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Gypsies, Travellers and Travelling Showpeople. 01909 533 533 13 Heritage Impact Assessment A Heritage Impact Assessment is required ... for listed buildin'

issues.detail: About 28 Full planning rows carry the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. Examples: Affordable Housing (10+ units, also outline), Sustainability Statement and SuDS (major development, including outline), Transport Assessment / Travel Plan (ST52 thresholds).
issues.evidence: 'Affordable Housing Statement: residential developments of 10+ units'

issues.detail: Several rows are not validation requirements or are mislabelled. 'CIL Additional Information / Form' is a list of viability cost headings. 'Pre-application advice' is advisory text. 'Design Code / Masterplan' is actually the illustrative layout and elevations plan requirement. 'Environmental Statement' is a passing reference ('might form part of an Environmental Statement').
issues.evidence: CIL trigger: 'Financing (e.g. loans) Professional fees (e.g. marketing, legal, architects, overheads) Contingency Other'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled or truncated. FRA begins with 'Contact details' and drops the FZ2/3/3b, critical drainage area and SFRA future-risk triggers. Ecological Survey reads 'Natural England ... default.aspx Development Schedule', where the source triggers are major applications, greenfield sites, hedgerows and mature trees, and buildings with bats or barn owls. Coal Mining ends 'Submission Documents on CD Two D'. Photographs reads 'required if the interior and exterior of the building that is proposed to be demolished'.
issues.evidence: Current page Ecological Appraisal: 'all major applications, greenfield sites, or sites affecting hedgerows, mature trees, woodland...'

issues.detail: Heritage Statement / HIA is not under Full planning, although the current page also requires it for development affecting the setting of a listed building or other heritage asset.
issues.evidence: 'Heritage Statement: listed building consent, demolition in a conservation area, or development affecting a listed building's setting or other heritage asset'

summary: The workbook links a superseded 2018 Core Strategy-era PDF with a metadata-based date. The current list is the council's web page under Local Plan 2020-2038 (updated Aug 2026). Grokbot's extraction mixes both sources, misses BNG, CTMP, HIA, LVIA, noise and other items, and contains boilerplate fragments and misassigned application types.
